Done. Ralph loop built, verified, committed in 5 units, tree clean.

**What a ralph loop is:** Geoffrey Huntley's [Ralph Wiggum technique](https://ghuntley.com/loop/) — a dumb `while true` that re-invokes a **fresh** agent session with the same prompt every iteration. Progress accumulates in files and git history, never in the model's context window; each pass does one small task until the checklist is empty. ([history](https://www.humanlayer.dev/blog/brief-history-of-ralph), [deep dive](https://www.zerosync.co/blog/ralph-loop-technical-deep-dive), [ghuntley/how-to-ralph-wiggum](https://github.com/ghuntley/how-to-ralph-wiggum))

**How `python3 ralph.py` works:**
1. Asks "What goal do you want done?" (e.g., `verify tests work`)
2. **Plan phase:** one opencode session (`opencode run --model opencode/deepseek-v4-flash-free`) breaks the goal into many mini tasks with descriptions, written as checkboxes to `ralph/tasks.md` + creates `ralph/progress.md`. Retries 3× if no usable plan appears.
3. **Loop phase:** up to 500 fresh sessions, each told: read AGENTS.md, pick exactly one unchecked task, complete it per repo rules (tests + commits), mark `[x]`, append to progress. Stops when zero `- [ ]` remain or agent replies `RALPH_DONE` with zero remaining.
4. **Rate limits:** subprocesses run with **no timeout** so opencode can wait them out itself (your ~20 h waits). If the process dies anyway, output is scanned for rate-limit phrasing and the loop sleeps 10 min and retries. Every session logged to `ralph/logs/` (git-ignored).

**Model:** `opencode/deepseek-v4-flash-free`, verified against your local `opencode models` (opencode 1.16.2). Max reasoning set via project `opencode.json` → `reasoningEffort: "high"` (the highest level opencode accepts).

**Per repo rules:** helpers proven first in `tests/test_ralph_helpers.py` (checkbox counting, sentinel, rate-limit detection, prompt contract, model pin) — `make lint` clean (mypy strict, 6 files), `make test` → **10 passed**. All 12 functions documented in `docs/functions.md`, journal entry written, 5 plain-message commits (`ce657ea`…`514ebac`).

One honest caveat, journaled: it hasn't been run against a live opencode session yet — first real run should be a tiny goal while watching `ralph/logs/plan_attempt_1.log`.
